info.title: Matomo Reporting API for ImageGraph plugin

get.description: Generates a static graph image for a Matomo report.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to query.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).

parameters.name: apiModule
parameters.description: API module name of the source report.

parameters.name: apiAction
parameters.description: API method name of the source report.

parameters.name: graphType
parameters.description: Optional graph type.

parameters.name: outputType
parameters.description: Output mode: inline image, saved file, or raw PHP graph object.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated metric names to plot.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated row labels to include for evolution graphs.

parameters.name: showLegend
parameters.description: Whether the graph legend should be displayed.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Optional graph width in pixels.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Optional graph height in pixels.

parameters.name: fontSize
parameters.description: Base font size used in the graph.

parameters.name: legendFontSize
parameters.description: Optional legend font size.

parameters.name: aliasedGraph
parameters.description: Whether anti-aliasing should be enabled.

parameters.name: idGoal
parameters.description: Optional goal ID for report methods that support goals.

parameters.name: colors
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated list of hex colors to use in the graph.

parameters.name: textColor
parameters.description: Hex color used for text.

parameters.name: backgroundColor
parameters.description: Hex color used for the background.

parameters.name: gridColor
parameters.description: Hex color used for grid lines.

parameters.name: idSubtable
parameters.description: Optional subtable ID for source reports that use subtables.

parameters.name: legendAppendMetric
parameters.description: Whether the metric name should be appended to legend labels.

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.

parameters.name: idDimension
parameters.description: Optional dimension ID for reports that support dimensions.

200.description:

tags.name: ImageGraph
tags.description:
The ImageGraph.get API call lets you generate beautiful static PNG Graphs for any existing Matomo report. Supported graph types are: line plot, 2D/3D pie chart and vertical bar chart. A few notes about some of the parameters available:
- $graphType defines the type of graph plotted, accepted values are: 'evolution', 'verticalBar', 'pie' and '3dPie'
- $colors accepts a comma delimited list of colors that will overwrite the default Matomo colors
- you can also customize the width, height, font size, metric being plotted (in case the data contains multiple columns/metrics). See also How to embed static Image Graphs? for more information.
